items.period: Shang dynasty script style (as labeled by the file page; no specific inscription date supplied)
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 京 in Shang oracle-bone script style, based on the B08320 form cited by the file page.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of an oracle-bone-style form identified as 京.
items.selection_reason: It is a character-specific, licensed early-form candidate and can illustrate the broad building interpretation while being clearly labeled as a redraw.
items.rights: Public domain, according to the Commons file page; attribution appreciated but not required.

limitations.text: The single selected example is a modern vector redraw of a script style, not a photograph or facsimile of a dated Shang inscription. A second Commons candidate based on a Kyoto University catalog scan was excluded because its file page identifies the form as 𢀛 rather than 京.
